title: validate policy
description: What `validate` holds this project to: data/validate.json, read by scripts/validate_tree.py (policy()). A project without the file has its git-tracked runs checked, no floors, no scorer sources and only the bundled demo's duplicate exception.

_comment.description: Notes for a person reading the file; validate ignores them.

committed.description: The arms reports cite, each an arm label's prefix (`runs`, `pair`, `repeats`, `linux`, `silver`, `adjudicated`, `judged-judge-summ-v1`, ...): V7 (every run has a first score), V8 (no duplicate config_id) and V9 (every tracked file on disk).

floors.description: V9: each arm (a label's prefix) must keep at least this many scores, so deleting evidence fails; raising one is a deliberate edit.

scorer_sources.description: V10: scores that claim the current scorer, and the code that says what the current scorer is.

arms.description: The arm, by its label's prefix (`runs`, `pair`, ...).

glob.description: Which of its scores, by their run's id.

path.description: Where in a score's record the scorer it claims is.

module.description: A .py path relative to this project's root.

callable.description: Returns a hash, or a dict of named hashes.

duplicate_ok.description: V8: (dataset_id, config_id) pairs allowed to repeat, each one justified.

systems.description: Globs, relative to this project's root, of systems kept outside data/systems (the examples'), found by their id and seen by every check of systems (V1's schema, V5, V18, V20).
